description: THE SOUTH GATE. The Gate Road runs up to a throat of scorched rockcrete where the Architect's Curtain parts — a single lit gap in a wall of humming hard light that seals the city's whole southern edge. Twin turret masts flank the road, their barrels tracking anything that stirs on the killing ground beyond. Guards in grey watch you with bored contempt: nobody sane goes south. The city is behind you. The wild is through the gap.
name: The South Gate
